newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks jump higher at opening, techs strong.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks jump higher at opening, techs strong.

text.p: U.S. stocks jumped higher at the opening on Monday with the Dow Jones industrial average outpacing the Nasdaq.
The long bond was off 6/32 to yield 6.75 percent.
The Dow was up 15.39 to 6,559, the Nasdaq Composite 3.83 higher at 1,314.51 and the S&P Index up 1.70 to 749.73.
